preconditions.description: The size of the array n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements in the array a must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query of type 1, the indices l and r must be valid and l must be less than or equal to r.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p, x in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query of type 2, the index p must be valid.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid else str(dif)
postconditions.description: For each query of type 1, output the minimum value of dif or -1 if it is impossible to choose k distinct integers.
For each query of type 2, update the element at index p to x.
